preconditions.description: The number of queries q is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= type_i <= 2 for type_i in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each query type is either 1 (add vertex) or 2 (query expected penalty).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= current_vertex_count for v_i in [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: For each query, the vertex v_i exists just before the query is processed.

preconditions.expression: any(type_i == 2 for type_i in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: There is at least one query of type 2 (output is non-empty).

postconditions.expression: all(0.0 <= float(line.strip()) <= max_possible_height for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip())
postconditions.description: Each output line for a type-2 query is a non-negative real number representing the expected penalty.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(float(output_line) - jury_answer) <= max(1e-6, 1e-6 * abs(jury_answer)) for output_line, jury_answer in zip(stdout.splitlines(), jury_answers))
postconditions.description: Each output line for a type-2 query matches the jury's answer within absolute or relative error 1e-6.
The number of output lines equals the number of type-2 queries.
